name: integrating-local-models
description: Integrate a local LLM (Ollama / LM Studio) or local audio model (Whisper STT / Kokoro / Piper TTS) into an app or agent, with a three-rung capability probe. Use when wiring a local model into an app or agent runner, choosing between Ollama and LM Studio, debugging local tool-calling failures, or picking a local STT/TTS model.
